title: The $300K Engineer Isn't Writing More Code
description:
The highest-paid engineers aren't writing more code — they're writing code that saves more money. Cut inference cost 8% on a production AI cluster and you're pointing at the bill, not asking for a salary. They live closest to the bottleneck. Why this career wins in 2026 — full video on the channel.

#AIEngineering #GPU #SystemsProgramming #TechCareers #Rust
